subject: Best option in cfa function for Discrete Data

messages.author: df0690f64a5fa593
messages.subject: Best option in cfa function for Discrete Data
parts:
Hi,

I have a model composed of 26 itens, where the values in each item are discrete, following a five points likert scale (1 to 5).
I have smooth range values of skewness and kurtosis: -0.934<sk<0.298 & -1.226<ku<1.301.
For cfa function in lavaan, estimator = "WLSMV" is the best option to be used?
Best,
Henrique

messages.author: af8b3df1f270185a
messages.subject: Re: Best option in cfa function for Discrete Data
parts:
There is an interesting paper comparing DWLS and WLSMV:

DiStefano, C., & Morgan, G. B. (2014). A comparison of diagonal weighted least squares robust estimation techniques for ordinal data. Structural Equation Modeling, 21(3), 425–438. https://doi.org/10.1080/10705511.2014.915373

Carlos
